About.title: About this tool
About.summary: Drop in one image and it builds a favicon and the PWA icons together, then hands them back as icons.zip. Everything is converted in the browser, so the image is never uploaded anywhere.
About.step1: Drop in one image, ideally close to square. Anything else is cropped to a square from the centre.
About.step2: Pick a shape for the favicon, the icon and the apple-icon: square, round or circle.
About.step3: If the image has a transparent background, choose a background colour. The favicon alone can stay transparent.
About.step4: Press download and you get icons.zip with the four files inside.

tooltip.appleIcon: For best compatibility, we recommend using “Square” or “Round”.
tooltip.background: If you are using a transparent background image, please set the background color.
tooltip.icon: For best compatibility, we recommend using “Square” or “Round”.
